# Emil's Kebab & Pizzeria

> Kebab, pizza and burgers at Støletorget in Sandviken, Bergen (Stølegaten 21). Named Bergen's best kebab by BT and Kebab of the Year at Wolt Awards 2023. Order for pickup or delivery.

- Address: Stølegaten 21, 5003 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 55 31 19 00
- Opening hours: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 11:00–22:45, Friday–Saturday 11:00–23:45
- Cuisine: kebab, pizza, burgers
- Rating: 4.6 (804 reviews)

## Order

- [Order for pickup](https://order.gastroplanner.no/s/emilskebabpizzeria)
- [Delivery via Wolt](https://wolt.com/nb/nor/bergen/restaurant/emils-kebab)
